questions.title: Mars terrain with no Earth twin
questions.note: Mars cells whose nearest Earth window is farther than the tie threshold (the Earth gap).

questions.title: New Earth twins in cold deserts (Köppen BWk)
questions.note: Earth windows not inside a known analog region, Köppen code 5 (BWk, arid cold). BSk (cold steppe) not included.

questions.title: Jezero rehearsal sites within 50 km of a town
questions.note: Top-10 Earth twins of Jezero whose nearest town (Natural Earth populated places) is within 50 km.

questions.title: Earth twins at least 90% under the target's landing limit
questions.note: Top-10 Earth twins of the targets whose landing share under their own body's limit is >= 90%. Only the windows with a persisted mission record have a value; the rest never match.

questions.title: Artemis III candidate regions with no Earth twin
questions.note: Targets whose mission is the Artemis III candidate region, with an Earth gap.
